title: Recipe 38 — Channel: Discord (Ed25519 verification, four interaction types, one daemon three channels)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Same channel shape as Slack and Telegram. Recipe 38 is the Discord deltas: a real signature to verify, and four interaction types instead of one message.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed recipe is never touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the three Discord values
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — Step 1's application id, bot token and public key, plus the API key for the boot beat.

beats.label: Name it, pick the shape, add the agent
beats.cue: “target: channel, one agent, one tool. Ten lines that are identical on every channel — the platform hasn't appeared yet.”

beats.label: Wire Discord
beats.cue: “Three fields, all needed: applicationId to register commands, botToken to post replies, publicKeyHex to prove the request came from Discord.”

beats.label: Decide what a conversation is
beats.cue: “sessionKey: thread — a guild thread carries parent_id, so it gets its own session, separate from the channel it hangs off.”

beats.label: Scope it before it goes unattended
beats.cue: An unattended daemon can't stop to ask you, so what it may do is declared up front.

beats.label: Lint the spec
beats.cue: “Parse plus the IR passes the compile path skips — nothing emitted yet.”

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “All three Discord values lower to {kind: env} refs. Even the public key — which isn't a secret — stays a reference, so the artifact is the same in every environment.”

verify.note: prints the IR for target channel — applicationId/botToken/publicKeyHex lower to {kind:"env"} refs

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check asserts the shape, installs the deps, and boots it: GREEN, with no Discord app in existence yet.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok (4 anchors); install ok; boot gated (boot reached its spec env refs gate)

beats.label: Open the emitted daemon
beats.cue: “Adapter, gateway, session router, janitor, SIGTERM handler — out of twenty-one lines of YAML.”

beats.label: Find Step 3's signature check
beats.cue: “Node's own crypto.verify against a 32-byte hex key, no SDK. And the same file ships the keypair generator the smoke signs test payloads with.”

verify.note: 6 lines — verifyDiscordSignature, the Ed25519 OID prefix that wraps the raw hex key, signDiscordBody and generateEd25519Keypair

beats.label: Ask run to run it
beats.cue: “run is the cli/browser REPL. A channel is a daemon — and the CLI names the shapes it takes instead of guessing.”

verify.note: deliberate rejection — `crewhaus run supports target: cli or browser (got "channel")`

beats.label: Boot the daemon with no secrets
beats.cue: “All three Discord vars named, then exit 2 — before it opens a socket.”
beats.command: env -u DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID -u DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN -u DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY -u ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY bun live/dist/daemon.ts

verify.note: designed refusal — `[daemon] missing required env vars: DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID, DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN, DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`; env -u scrubs what Setup sourced

beats.label: Give the interactions endpoint a public URL
beats.cue: [manual] The recipe's `ngrok http 3000` — then paste the tunnel plus /discord/events into the portal's Interactions tab. Discord PINGs it, the adapter PONGs, and the portal saves.

verify.note: needs ngrok (or any tunnel) and a second terminal; the interactions URL itself is pasted by hand in Discord's Developer Portal, and it only saves if a live PING gets a PONG

beats.label: Boot the daemon for real
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Three Discord values and an API key: it's listening on :3000 for /discord/events.”

verify.note: needs DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID + DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN + DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY + Anthropic credentials; serves the gateway on PORT (default 3000)

groups.title: One more thing · one daemon, three channels

beats.label: Swap the channels block for the recipe's three-channel one
beats.cue: “Straight from the recipe's side-by-side section: replace the discord block with Slack, Discord and Telegram together. Nothing else in the spec changes.”

beats.label: Check the three-channel bundle
beats.cue: “Same money beat, three platforms: GREEN. One gateway, three URL prefixes, three session spaces.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok (4 anchors); install ok; boot gated (boot reached its spec env refs gate). The emitted daemon imports channel-adapter-slack, -telegram and -discord alongside -base

beats.label: Boot it with none of the seven
beats.cue: “Seven platform variables, from three channels, all named in one line — then exit 2. That list is generated, not written.”
beats.command: env -u SLACK_BOT_TOKEN -u SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET -u DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID -u DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN -u DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY -u TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN -u TELEGRAM_SECRET_TOKEN -u ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY bun live/multi/daemon.ts

verify.note: designed refusal naming all seven: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN, SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET, TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_SECRET_TOKEN, DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID, DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN, DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY, then the provider credential

beats.label: Run the recipe's smoke
beats.cue: “The five things the recipe says it validates: PING, slash command, component click, modal submit, and Ed25519 both ways.”

verify.note: all probes pass with no key — the smoke generates its own Ed25519 keypair; probe F (live channel post) self-skips without DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN + CREWHAUS_DISCORD_LIVE_CHANNEL_ID
